title: Patch: a random cast's prompts pick only targets its caster could have chosen
notes: R452, R656, R4353002: a random cast's target prompts filter options through the targeting point first, so it never targets Evasive, Immune to Spells, or Dormant cards, and an enemy-aimed cast keeps friendly options when its only enemy option is out of reach.

player.title: Random Cast Targeting
fixes: Spells cast at random that ask you to choose a target now pick only legal targets, so they never target Evasive or Dormant cards, or Units Immune to Spells.
